Commissione, notizie.titolo: New guidance on electricity imports under Centralised Clearance for Import (CCI)

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU releases €16 million in humanitarian aid for Myanmar and Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Union has allocated an additional €16 million in humanitarian aid to help communities impacted by the ongoing conflict in Myanmar, as well as Rohingya refugees and their host communities in Bangladesh.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission initiates safeguard investigation into imports of PET resin chemicals
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the Commission initiated a safeguard investigation to assess whether safeguard measures are needed to protect EU industry from a significant increase in imports of polyethylene terephthalate (PET) resin chemicals.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU to push for accelerated global climate action at COP31
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: At the COP31 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9-20 November, the European Union will work with international partners to accelerate global climate action and deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU actions to prevent and combat child poverty explained to children and young people
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: A new child-friendly publication, “Breaking the cycle of child poverty - Strengthening the European Child Guarantee”, explains how the EU is working towards every child having a fair chance in life.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission opens negotiations to extend ‘Roam Like at Home’ to the Western Balkans
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: As announced by President Ursula von der Leyen during her travel to the Western Balkans in October 2026, the European Commission has opened negotiations to integrate Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Serbia into the EU's ‘Roam Like at Home' regime.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: European Responsible Housing Awards open for applications
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The 2027 edition of the European Responsible Housing Awards is open for applications until 31 December 2026.

Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Over three decades of the European Union’s flagship programme for researcher training, mobility and career development

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU to push for accelerated global climate action at COP31
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: At the COP31 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9-20 November, the European Union will work with international partners to accelerate global climate action and deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Paris Peace Forum 2026: Mediating Together for a Peace That Lasts
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission’s Service for Foreign Policy Instruments (FPI) will put the spotlight on how peace mediation is adapting to a changing world at the Paris Peace Forum 2026, with its thematic panel “Peace Mediation Today: New Actors, New Coalitions, Lasting Results” on 10 November.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: How social dialogue can help prevent, prepare for and respond to crises
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: At the 2026 Civil Protection Forum, employers and trade unions discussed how social dialogue can help prevent, prepare for and respond to crises. Social partners discuss strengthening preparedness at the Civil Protection Forum.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission disburses €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission disbursed €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan. This payment includes €3.7 billion for the second instalment of macro-financial assistance (MFA) agreed for 2026 and €658 million under the defence leg of the Loan.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commissioner Lahbib co-hosts InvestFrontier launching event, bringing together humanitarian actors, financial institutions, businesses and philanthropy
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Commissioner for Equality, Preparedness and Crisis Management Hadja Lahbib is participating in the kick-off meeting of the InvestFrontier initiative, held in Brussels on 6 November 2026, and bringing together humanitarian aid, business and philanthropy.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches strategy to strengthen vocational skills across Europe
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission adopted the European VET strategy as part of the Education and Skills package. Through the strategy, the EU will better support EU countries in modernising their VET systems.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission aims to unlock business opportunities for EU medical device companies in China
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is today leading a delegation of European medical device companies to Shanghai to support new business opportunities in the Chinese market.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission invites nominations for the next President of the European Research Council
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Research and innovation news alert: The European Commission has launched the search for the next President of the European Research Council (ERC), inviting nominations for a scientific leader to champion frontier research and represent European science on the world stage.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Shaping Europe’s future through education and training
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The education and skills package helps reverse the decline in basic skills and improve teaching and how digital tools and AI are used in education

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU Maritime Security Strategy: joint report highlights progress
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission and the High Representative have presented the first Joint Report on the implementation of the EU Maritime Security Strategy since 2023.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission presents its Vision 2040 for a thriving fisheries and aquaculture sector
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission presented its Vision for fisheries and aquaculture towards 2040, setting the direction for the next 15 years to strengthen the environmental and economic viability of the sector.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission meeting on sanctions implementation brings together Member States and international partners
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The eighth meeting of the High‑Level Group on Union Restrictive Measures (sanctions) is being held today 5 November 2026.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission launches second Annual Migration Management Cycle
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: On 6 November, the Commission launched the second Annual Migration Management Cycle, providing a comprehensive overview of migration trends and risks in the EU over the previous year, identifying Member States facing migratory pressure, and proposing the establishment of the second Solidarity Pool.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: The European Commission and European Space Agency launch a joint website showcasing collaborative research on our changing planet
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The joint Earth System Science Initiative connects European research projects to better understand environmental change and provide knowledge relevant to European policies and society.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Commission strengthens Europe’s position as the world’s leading tourism destination
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The Commission presents a new EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy, to increase the sector’s competitiveness, sustainability and resilience.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: EU sets out a new Strategy for the Arctic
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The EU's new Arctic Strategy builds on issues identified in the EU’s 2021 Arctic policy and responds to the major geopolitical, security and environmental changes that have taken place since then.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Results of 04-11-2026 auction (EU-Bills)
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Auction results EU-Bills.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: 2026 Enlargement Package shows that reform commitment delivers progress towards EU membership
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: Today, the European Commission adopted its annual Enlargement Package, taking stock of progress made by the enlargement partners over the past year and setting out reform priorities for the way forward.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Hospitals and healthcare social partners celebrate 20 years of social dialogue
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: For two decades, the EU Sectoral Social Dialogue Committee for Hospitals and Healthcare has delivered joint solutions to support workers, employers and resilient healthcare systems across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Biomethane Mechanism: First matching round to connect buyers and suppliers
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: The European Commission is launching the first matching round under the Biomethane Mechanism to bring potential buyers and suppliers of biomethane together across Europe.

Commissione, notizie.titolo: Eurostat: Non-household electricity prices fall further in 2026
Commissione, notizie.descrizione: In the first half of 2026, the average price of electricity for non-household consumers in the EU was €0.18 per kilowatt-hour (kWh).
